title.en: Look for proxy hints in response headers
title.hinglish: Response headers mein proxy ke hints dekho

why.en: Sites behind a reverse proxy or CDN often reveal it in headers such as Server, Via or X-Cache.
why.hinglish: Reverse proxy ya CDN ke peeche wali sites aksar Server, Via ya X-Cache jaise headers mein khud ko bata deti hain.

expect.en: Response headers such as 'Server: gws' or 'Via'. You see one front address, not the many servers behind it. Output varies by site and location.
expect.hinglish: 'Server: gws' ya 'Via' jaise response headers. Aapko ek front address dikhta hai, uske peeche ke kai servers nahi. Output site aur location ke hisaab se alag hota hai.

title.en: See which address you really talk to
title.hinglish: Dekho aap asal mein kis address se baat karte ho

why.en: A big site resolves to the address of its proxy or load balancer, not of an individual app server.
why.hinglish: Badi site ka naam uske proxy ya load balancer ke address pe resolve hota hai, kisi individual app server ke nahi.

expect.en: One or a few public IP addresses. They belong to the front door, like 203.0.113.10 in the lesson. Addresses vary.
expect.hinglish: Ek ya kuch public IP addresses. Ye front door ke hote hain, jaise lesson ka 203.0.113.10. Addresses alag ho sakte hain.

title.en: Find the health checks and the 502 in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein health checks aur 502 dhoondo

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark and filter for the health-check requests and the gateway error.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur health-check requests aur gateway error filter karo.

expect.en: GET /healthz requests on the private network, requests carrying an X-Forwarded-For header, and in the bad-gateway capture a 502 Bad Gateway response.
expect.hinglish: Private network pe GET /healthz requests, X-Forwarded-For header wali requests, aur bad-gateway capture mein 502 Bad Gateway response.
